newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold easier, trade dominated by arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold easier, trade dominated by arbitrage.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell to 1,335 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 1,954 kilos with trade dominated by arbitrage, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $341.00 an ounce and 1,562,000 lira per gram compared to $342.00 and 1,571,000 lira on Wednesday, in line with lower levels on European markets.
"There isn't as much physical demand coming from the country, as would normally be expected. We can say that nearly all of the day's trade was due to arbitrage," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira firmed slightly to 142,490 lira to the dollar, versus the previous close of 142,510 lira, helping banks to engage in arbitrage deals.
Most of the the day's trade -- 1,040 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 67.0 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
